name: FeedTheMonsterJS
request:
Modify this existing FeedTheMonsterJS project in place. Requirements:
1. Replace the vowel "a" audio with the short sound /æ/ (as in "cat"), NOT the letter name "ay". Also check other vowels for short sound correctness.
2. Replace the font used for letters/text with "Playwrite South Africa" (Google Font, designed for SA primary handwriting).
3. Fix the known bug: when the timer ends, user input should be disabled.
4. Fix the audio playback order bug: wrong-answer reaction audio should play BEFORE the monster spitting audio.
5. Ensure the "Fantastic" praise audio is not cut off.
6. Keep all existing South African language localizations and attribution (BSD 2-clause LICENSE + CC-BY).
